<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="accent" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="4"/>
      <feOffset dy="3"/>
      <feComponentTransfer>
        <feFuncA type="linear" slope=".12"/>
      </feComponentTransfer>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="20" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">9:41</text>
  <line x1="323" y1="18" x2="323" y2="14" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="328" y1="18" x2="328" y2="12" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="333" y1="18" x2="333" y2="10" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>

  <rect x="363" y="12" width="14" height="7" rx="1" fill="#96E063"/>
  <rect x="382" y="13" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#4A4A4A"/>

  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="65" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- balance card -->
  <g filter="url(#softShadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="113" width="350" height="126" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="20" y="113" width="7" height="126" rx="3.5" fill="url(#accent)"/>
  </g>
  <text x="42" y="143" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">AVAILABLE BALANCE</text>
  <text x="42" y="184" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">$20.00</text>
  <text x="42" y="213" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Available earnings ready to transfer</text>

  <line x1="330" y1="147" x2="344" y2="147" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- transfer speed -->
  <text x="20" y="404" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Transfer speed</text>

  <text x="20" y="535" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Transfer amount</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="550" width="350" height="48" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="42" y="581" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">$20.00</text>
    <text x="348" y="580" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">MAX</text>
  </g>
  <text x="20" y="624" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Instant transfer fee</text>

  <!-- confirm button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="56" y="687" width="278" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#accent)"/>
    <text x="195" y="714" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">CONFIRM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="761" width="390" height="83" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="761" x2="390" y2="761" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,787 48,779 57,787 57,799 51,799 51,791 45,791 45,799 39,799" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="48" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="145" cy="788" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="152" y1="795" x2="158" y2="801" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="145" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Discover</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <polyline points="232,785 238,791 244,785" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="229" y="790" width="18" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="238" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Activity</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="335" cy="785" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="335" cy="799" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="335" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
